_comment: EXTERNAL REFERENCE pane, wired to a real recorded talk. `talk.mp4` is the excerpt kept from it, with the burned-in caption strip cropped off. The extracted frames are the figure region as captured, each also de-captioned; they carry no in-video timestamp: the slide barely changes across the excerpt, so there is nothing honest to match them against, and they are numbered in capture order instead. The transcript is the talk's own, split into sentences and trimmed to the six that describe the figure, one per extracted frame, in the same order. It has no per-line timings in the source, so the lines are numbered rather than timed.

frames.line: The audio processing module applies STFT to get 2D spectrograms which are fed to the cross-modal encoder.
The visual stream processing path comprises a HorizonNet-based backbone to obtain 1D feature sequences, which are subsequently passed to the cross-modal geometry-aware attention subnetwork.
The cross-modal conformer block powered by geometry-aware attention sub-network generates a complex ideal ratio mask.
A vocoder is used to estimate the clean audio from the estimated spectrogram generated from the Complex Mask.
The Spectrogram Prediction Loss helps in learning to reconstruct the clean spectrogram.
The Acoustic Token Matching Loss is an SSL inspired loss; the HuBERT model enables it to protect inherent speech characteristics, like phonetic and prosodic properties.

transcript.label: Transcript

lines.text: The input clean audio is converted to spectrogram by applying STFT which is convolved with RIR to obtain the noisy spectrogram.
The model is fed with a panoramic image where a horizon net based feature extractor is used to obtain the geometry layout specific visual features.
Features at each time step are passed through a conformer based cross-modal encoder.
This comprises a bunch of feedforward, self-attention, cons, and our proposed geometry aware cross-modal attention subnetwork.
After passing the output of the conformer block through a complex mask decoder, we obtain the estimated spectrogram, which is then passed through a vocoder to obtain the estimated clean audio.

The first of the two objective functions used is the spectrogram prediction loss, which is calculated between the ground truth and the estimated spectrograms the acoustic token matching loss is calculated between the latent representation of the clean speech which is obtained through a pre-trained hubert model and the predicted pseudo levels of the estimate

transcript._note: Six lines for six frames. The excerpt's first three sentences are the speaker introducing the talk before the figure is on screen ('overview of our proposed approach', 'we discussed the individual components in the following slides', 'highlighted part is the audio processing module'); the extracted sequence begins at the sentence where the figure itself starts being explained. Keeping them would have made the transcript nine lines against six frames and implied a pairing that does not hold.

blurb: Human authored oral presentations from premier conferences were collected and filtered for those in which process diagrams are incrementally presented. The videos were trimmed in time and cropped in space to represent the nature of our pipeline outputs. The transcript was also collected and aligned to the extracted frames.
